answer: A concrete approach: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The ocean of work and the umber of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a knoll to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
